name: browser-screenshot
description: Capture PNG screenshots of public HTTP(S) web pages with desktop, tablet, mobile, or custom viewports through a remote MCP service.

interface.longDescription: Open a public HTTP(S) web page in an isolated Chromium browser and return a PNG screenshot. Choose desktop, tablet, mobile, or custom viewport settings and optionally capture the full page.
defaultPrompt: Take a desktop screenshot of this public web page.
Capture this page as a mobile screenshot.
Take a full-page screenshot of this URL.

positive.description: Capture a desktop screenshot of a public HTTPS page.
positive.prompt: Take a desktop screenshot of https://example.com.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls screenshot_create for the supplied public HTTPS URL with the desktop viewport and returns the PNG plus the service-provided metadata.

positive.description: Capture a mobile screenshot of a public page.
positive.prompt: Show me https://example.com as a mobile screenshot.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls screenshot_create with the mobile viewport preset and returns exactly the resulting screenshot and metadata.

positive.prompt: Take a full-page screenshot of https://example.com.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls screenshot_create with fullPage enabled and reports the returned dimensions and duration without inventing values.
Calls screenshot_create using the requested custom viewport dimensions and returns the PNG result.

positive.description: Capture one tablet screenshot without creating unrequested variants.
positive.prompt: Take one tablet screenshot of https://example.com.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls screenshot_create once with the tablet preset and does not create additional desktop or mobile captures.

negative.description: Do not use Browser Screenshot to interact with or modify a web page.
negative.prompt: Log in to this site and submit the form for me.

negative.description: Do not use Browser Screenshot to access a local or private network resource.
Do not use Browser Screenshot when no screenshot or visual capture is requested.
negative.prompt: Explain what responsive web design means.

publication.release_notes: Initial Marketplace package with remote MCP configuration, screenshot workflow skill, public support/privacy/terms pages, review cases, and plugin icons.
